name: NASA
notes: Lead Artemis agency; CLPS customer.

name: ESA
notes: Orion ESM; Moonlight LCNS; Argonaut lander; MAGPIE rover.

name: CNSA
notes: Chang'e robotic program and ILRS.

name: CMSA
notes: Crewed lunar: Long March 10, Mengzhou, Lanyue.

name: Roscosmos
notes: Luna-26+ after Luna-25 failure; ILRS partner.

name: JAXA
notes: LUPEX rover with ISRO; Gateway contributions historically.

name: ISRO
notes: Chandrayaan-3 success; sample return and LUPEX.

name: CSA
notes: Artemis II crew Hansen; Canadarm3 for Gateway.

name: KARI
notes: KPLO/Danuri orbiter (2022); leads national KPLL lander with KASA.

name: MBRSC

name: SpaceX
notes: Starship HLS; Falcon 9/Heavy for many CLPS missions.

name: Blue Origin
notes: Blue Moon MK1 cargo / MK2 crew; New Glenn; VIPER option; LTV delivery.

name: Intuitive Machines
notes: Nova-C IM-1..IM-4; first commercial soft landing.

name: Firefly Aerospace
notes: Blue Ghost M1 success; M2 far side; M3 Gruithuisen; MoonFall drones.

name: Astrobotic
notes: Peregrine failed 2024; Griffin-1 Moon Base II.

name: ispace
notes: Hakuto-R M1/M2 failures; ULTRA M3/M4; ispace-Europe MAGPIE.

name: ispace-Europe
notes: ESA MAGPIE prime (Phase 2).

name: Axiom Space
notes: AxEMU xEVA suits with Prada.

name: Astrolab
notes: FLIP rover on Griffin; CLV-1 crewed LTV.

name: Lunar Outpost
notes: Pegasus crewed LTV; MAPP heritage.

name: Draper
notes: APEX 1.0 south pole CLPS.

name: Lockheed Martin
notes: Orion prime.

name: Boeing
notes: SLS core stage / exploration systems.

name: Northrop Grumman
notes: HALO; SLS boosters; LID demos.

name: SSTL
notes: Lunar Pathfinder relay.

name: NPO Lavochkin
notes: Luna series spacecraft developer.

name: CASC
notes: Long March launch vehicles; spacecraft.

name: Prada
notes: AxEMU outer layer and LCVG partnership.

name: KASA
notes: Korea AeroSpace Administration; lunar lander roadmap and CLPS payloads.

name: SUPARCO
notes: Pakistan space agency; Jinnah-1 rover on Chang'e-8; ILRS partner.

name: Telespazio
notes: Prime of Moonlight LCNS industrial consortium for ESA.

name: Thales Alenia Space
notes: Argonaut Lunar Descent Element prime (Italy entity); historical Gateway modules.

name: Fleet Space
notes: SPIDER seismic payload on Blue Ghost Mission 2.

name: Volta Space
notes: LightPort wireless power demo on Blue Ghost Mission 2.

name: CAST
notes: China Academy of Space Technology; Chang'e spacecraft.

name: Australian Space Agency
notes: National agency funding Roo-ver and Australian CLPS payloads (e.g. Fleet SPIDER).

name: MDA Space
notes: Builder of Canadarm3; adapting robotics for lunar-surface/Moon Base logistics after Gateway pause.

name: Toyota
notes: Partner with JAXA on crewed pressurized lunar rover (Lunar Cruiser nickname).

name: Voyager Technologies
notes: Acquired Astrobotic in July 2026; lunar business operates as Voyager Lunar Systems (Griffin, Peregrine).

name: ASI
notes: Italian Space Agency; leads the Multi-Purpose Habitation surface module with Thales Alenia Space Italy.

name: Altec
notes: Thales Alenia Space / ASI joint venture supporting MPH design and future lunar operations.

name: DARPA
notes: US defence research agency funding lunar architecture studies (LunA-10) and the LASSO water-ice orbiter.

name: Benchmark Space Systems
notes: In-space propulsion company; DARPA LASSO Phase 1 performer with the Sapphire orbiter concept.

name: Quantum Space
notes: Cislunar platform developer; DARPA LASSO Phase 1 performer offering its Ranger spacecraft.

name: Revolution Space
notes: DARPA LASSO Phase 1 performer; concept not publicly described.

name: JPL
notes: NASA centre managed by Caltech; builds CADRE and the MoonFall hopper drones, manages the MoonFall mission.

name: Maxar
notes: Built the Gateway Power and Propulsion Element now being repurposed for the SR-1 Freedom NEP demo.

name: ULA
notes: Supplies the Centaur V upper stage selected in March 2026 to replace ICPS on standardized SLS.

name: US State Department
notes: Co-leads Artemis Accords outreach and implementation with NASA.

name: ArianeGroup
notes: Ariane 6 prime; four-booster Ariane 64 is the launcher for ESA Argonaut cargo landers.

name: OHB System
notes: Argonaut Lunar Descent Element GNC, telecommunications, power, solar arrays and batteries.

name: Nammo
notes: Designs and supplies the main engine for ESA's first Argonaut Lunar Descent Element (UK site).

name: IKI
notes: Space Research Institute of the Russian Academy of Sciences; science lead for the Luna missions.

name: Rosatom
notes: Russian state nuclear corporation; participant in the planned ILRS lunar power plant with the Kurchatov Institute.

name: Canadensys Aerospace
notes: Canadian lunar payload and rover developer; one of three CSA Lunar Utility Vehicle concept teams.

name: Mission Control
notes: Canadian lunar autonomy and operations company; CSA Lunar Utility Vehicle concept team.

name: NARIT
notes: National Astronomical Research Institute of Thailand; built the CE-7 MATCH cosmic-ray payload for Chang'e-7.

name: ILOA
notes: International Lunar Observatory Association; ILO-C camera payload flying on Chang'e-7.
